items.title: Leo becomes first Pope to visit Algeria at start of major Africa tour

items.summary: Pope Leo XIV wants to "turn the world's attention to Africa", according to a senior Vatican official, as he embarks on a significant tour of the continent addressing themes of peace, migration and dialogue between religions.
items.summary_zh: 教宗利奥十四想"把世界的注意力转向非洲",梵蒂冈的一位高级官员认为,他开始对非洲大陆进行重要的巡演,探讨和平,迁徙和宗教间的对话等主题.

items.title: The US blockade of Iran is a gamble. Will it work?
items.title_zh: 美国封锁伊朗是一场赌博. 有用吗?
items.summary: There's no doubt the US military has the capability to mount a blockade of vessels moving in and out of the Gulf. The question is: to what end?

items.title: Peru election drags into second day after ballot delivery fiasco
items.title_zh: 秘鲁选举在投票失败后第二天被拖入选举。
items.summary: The results of the general election in Peru have been delayed after tens of thousands of people were unable to vote due to technical and logistical problems at a number of polling stations.
items.summary_zh: 由于一些投票站的技术和后勤问题,数万人无法投票,秘鲁大选结果被推迟.

items.title: Iran carried out highest number of executions in decades

items.summary: Iran executed at least 1,639 people last year, the highest number recorded there since 1989, two non-governmental organisations say.
items.summary_zh: 伊朗去年处决了至少1 639人,这是自1989年以来的最高数字。

items.summary: Budapest's iconic Chain Bridge links both sides of the city - beautiful Buda with vibrant Pest - across the river Danube. At night, the lights that illuminate the bridge shimmer like mini moons in the waters below.
items.summary_zh: 布达佩斯的标志性链桥连接了城市两侧——美丽的布达与生机勃勃的佩斯——跨越多瑙河. 晚上,灯光照亮了桥 就像迷你月亮在下面的水里

items.summary: What Viktor Orbán did for the last 16 years in power was "an experiment" - but even he didn't know what to call it. "Illiberal democracy" sounded too negative.
items.summary_zh: 维克多·奥尔班在过去16年的掌权中所做的是"一个实验"——但连他都不知道该怎么称呼它. "自由民主"听起来太消极了.

items.title: Eight to be awarded for bravery in Bondi Junction stabbing

items.summary: Eight Australians who stepped in to protect strangers during the deadly Bondi Junction stabbing will be recognised for their bravery.
items.summary_zh: 八名澳大利亚人在致命的邦迪口被刺杀时 介入保护陌生人 将因其英勇而被认出来

items.title: Political turmoil in Indian border state as nine million lose voting rights

items.title: The Dutch village at risk of being demolished

items.summary_zh: 在荷兰南部,除了宽阔的河口外,约有1100人的村庄很可能从地图上消失.

items.title: On patrol with Canadian forces securing the Arctic as global threats grow

items.summary_zh: 一排简单的花生树 标志着加拿大军队预备役人员和作战成员的终点线 经过两个月的马拉松运动 穿过地球上最恶劣的环境之一: 加拿大的北极地区

items.title: Trump's threat raises risks and leaves predicaments unchanged

items.summary: After a diplomatic team led by US Vice-President JD Vance tried, and failed, to reach a negotiated agreement to end the war with Iran on Saturday, President Donald Trump had to decide his next move.
items.summary_zh: 在由美国副总统旺斯(JD Vance)率领的外交团队试图并未能通过谈判达成协议以在星期六结束同伊朗的战争后,唐纳德·特朗普总统不得不决定他的下一步行动.

items.title: 'We need real peace': Ukrainians have little faith in Easter truce

items.summary_zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰商定的东正教复活节停战协定于星期六下午生效,但38分钟后,我们在乌克兰东北部的哈尔科夫听到空袭警报。

items.title: At least 30 feared dead in crush at Haitian tourist site

items.summary: At least 30 people are feared to have been killed in a stampede at a popular tourist site in Haiti on Saturday.
items.summary_zh: 至少有30人担心星期六在海地一个受欢迎的旅游地点被踩踏而丧生.

items.title: Why this disillusioned Trump voter spends hours searching Epstein files

items.title: 'It's a special thing to be on Planet Earth': Artemis crew welcomed home in Houston
